A full-fidelity desktop website design comp, 16:9 landscape, showing the top of the page at 1440 px wide, rendered edge to edge as the page itself (no browser window around the page, no device). The website for PrismTTY, a live terminal-output highlighter for network engineers, executed as a best-in-class dark developer-tool landing page at Linear's level of craft. Near-black ground (#0a0b0d), text #f2f3f5, secondary text #8b9099, hairline borders #23252a, one refined sans for type and a clean monospace for code.

Regions:
1. Top navigation bar: at left a small prism-triangle logo mark (an outlined triangle with a tiny terminal window inside) and the wordmark "PrismTTY"; at right the links "Profiles", "Install", "Docs", "GitHub".
2. Left column: a large tight headline "Readable output, live in your terminal.", a two-line lede "PrismTTY colors SSH, console, pipe and log output as it flows, and one wrapped shell follows you from device to device.", then an install chip "$ brew install inxbit/tap/prismtty" with a copy icon, and a secondary ghost button "View on GitHub". Under it a quiet facts line "9 built-in profiles · macOS and Linux · MIT".
3. Right column, the focal element: a polished terminal window (thin title bar reading "ptty /bin/zsh", a small badge "profile: cisco") showing real highlighted Cisco output: "LAB-IOS-01#show interfaces description", then rows "Gi1/0/1  up  up  Uplink to LAB-CORE", "Gi1/0/2  down  down  Spare access port", "Po10  up  up  Bundle to DIST-A", "Vlan1191  up  up  Synthetic users VLAN", then "LAB-IOS-01#show ip route" and "O  192.0.2.0/24 [110/20] via 198.51.100.1, 00:00:14, Vlan1191". The prompt is white, interface names bright blue #0099ff, every "up" pure green #00ff00, "down" bold pure red #ff0000, IP addresses cyan #00ffff.
4. At the bottom edge, the start of a three-column feature row with small headings "Network-aware profiles", "Follows every hop", "ChromaTerm-compatible" and one line of text under each.

Calm, premium, precise spacing. No neon glow, no gradient blobs. Real readable text at real size, about 16 px body on a 1440 px page.
